findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "sec-forensics-whistleblower" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_ofac_entity, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, redeem_checkout_session · Private data: screen_ofac_entity, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, provision_agent_key, redeem_checkout_session · Public sink: redeem_checkout_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_ofac_entity, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, redeem_checkout_session · Private data: screen_ofac_entity, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, provision_agent_key, redeem_checkout_session · Public sink: redeem_checkout_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
